title: Temporary Foreign Worker Protection Act
verified_how: Fetched CiviX 18045. It shows 'Temporary Foreign Worker Protection Act [SBC 2018] CHAPTER 45 Assented to November 8, 2018' and 'current to September 15, 2026', with Part 2 'Licences for Foreign Worker Recruiters'.
notes: Covers only provincial licensing of recruiters and registration of employers of foreign workers. Work permits and immigration themselves are federal (Immigration and Refugee Protection Act).
